overview: Roadie Roster is a store staffing app for managing roadie positions, rosters, sign-ups and exports.
features: Kiosk self-service sign-up with a welcome screen
Dashboard showing seeded positions, build-to totals, schedule, store info, checklists and retention settings
Roster with roadie cards, on-hand counts and open spots
Shareable and Full exports that differ only in contact details
Contact details visible only to Admin and Store Manager
